# External candidates · Qualification after Stage 3

The owner reviewed Stage 3 at `61397c1`. The late binding–accessibility estimate, model-specific regional methylation results, the original eight array probe IDs, their geometry, and the sole native scored-motif CpG were exposed. Source routing identified exact library aliases and four matching zero-cycle barcodes before this freeze. No alignment of study outcomes, enrichment or per-arm external beta contrast is part of this qualification.

**Yin.** Anchor on the individual human JUN full-length and FOXP1 extended DNA-binding-domain experiments in PRJEB9797. Confirm the protocol from each experiment XML, exact construct, barcode, successive selection cycle, file checksum and read count. Match the four barcode strings to ZeroCycle samples in the authors' PRJEB20112. Keep the chemical attribution of an input distinct from documented barcode/sequence composition and from methylation of each selected molecule. Use the Stage 1 mm10 sequence for the lone CpG-bearing scored motif. Screen only three nested, fixed words: the exact 12-bp scored window, that window with two native bases on either side (16 bp), and its CpG plus the adjacent intact AP1 heptamer (9 bp). Count presence in either orientation within a deposited 40-base randomized insert, once per read; include zeroes, library read denominators and distinct supporting inserts. Record other read lengths, ambiguous bases and strand counts. No enriched-word search, test, estimated methylation effect or merging cycles as replicates. Separate observed feasibility of the exact local sequence, shorter context and full amplicon from chemical binding or late maintenance.

**Array.** Reconcile the eight preidentified unmasked measured GPL30650 probes in the original five amplicons to exact reference mm10 CG dyads, existing common plus-C coordinates, explicit assayed strands and native coverage on the interrogated genomic base. Use the deposited two-base half-open target, independent annotation strand (v8.6 MM285 mm10 coordinate table in its matching probe order), plus-C at start and reference G at start+1. A minus-strand interrogated C lies opposite that reference G. Check target string, mask, target width and exact reference sequence; preserve disagreements without moving probes to a nearby site. Retain plus-C and opposite-base native coverage separately for P4 and tissue vehicle, and distinguish core from flanks. Map all 12 array columns to GSM, mouse sample and treatment using raw-channel filenames and original GEO records. For the eight probes only report finite beta availability and counts per arm. Pin the treatment and collection schedule, preparation and published detection criterion. No arrays are paired to Nagaraja mice. No external treatment effect, broad outcome search or qualification of another dataset is authorized.

The final decision distinguishes what either candidate can answer about methylation-dependent JUN–FOXP1 binding and late maintenance from narrower, source-supported uses. [Stage 3 results](../stage3/RESULTS.md) · [Previous deposit scan](../../post_s5/JUN_FOXP1_DEPOSIT_SCAN.md)
